title: Term not falsified
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $T$ be a conjunction of literals with pairwise distinct coordinates, and let $\\rho$ assign each coordinate either no restriction or a fixed sign. The term is not falsified when none of its literals is falsified by $\\rho$.
